title: Волшебный круг Гуру-Гуру. Фильм
alt: Волшебный круг Гуру-Гуру (1996) Magical Circle Guru Guru Movie 魔法陣グルグル
description: The hero Nike and magic user Kukuri learn of the "Pickle of Happiness", an item that will grant a wish to the one who eats it. With the help of old friends, they must beat the monsters to the Pickle and convince its guardian dragon to give it to them. (Source: Anime News Network)

en:
The hero Nike and magic user Kukuri learn of the "Pickle of Happiness", an item that will grant a wish to the one who eats it. With the help of old friends, they must beat the monsters to the Pickle and convince its guardian dragon to give it to them.



(Source: Anime News Network)
